metadata.directionPolicy: For manifestation -> concept, broadMatch means the target concept is broader; narrowMatch means the target concept is narrower.
metadata.reviewPolicy: Discovery mappings do not authorize aggregation; disease, case definition, surveillance intensity, denominator and period must be verified.

concepts.label: Malaria parasite incidence
concepts.definition: Confirmed malaria cases in a year per 1,000 population under surveillance.

mappings.rationale: Annual parasite incidence is the programme manifestation; interpretation requires concurrent surveillance intensity.
differences: dependent on case detection and ABER

concepts.label: Malaria surveillance intensity
concepts.definition: Population blood-examination coverage used to assess the intensity of malaria surveillance.

mappings.rationale: ABER is the core programme manifestation, calculated using blood examinations and population.
differences: blood examinations rather than unique people may be counted

concepts.label: Malaria test positivity
concepts.definition: Malaria-positive examinations among source-defined blood slides or tests examined.

mappings.rationale: Slide positivity is a microscopy-specific manifestation; test positivity may also be defined for other diagnostic technologies.

concepts.label: Plasmodium falciparum share of malaria
concepts.definition: Confirmed P. falciparum cases among confirmed malaria cases under the source-defined classification.

mappings.rationale: The programme manifestation represents Pf share; mixed infections and diagnostic rules must be verified.

concepts.label: Vector-borne disease case fatality
concepts.definition: Deaths attributed to a specified vector-borne disease among reported cases of that disease.

mappings.rationale: The manifestation is restricted to malaria and is narrower than the disease-family concept.
The manifestation is restricted to dengue and is narrower than the disease-family concept.
The manifestation is restricted to Japanese encephalitis and is narrower than the disease-family concept.

concepts.label: Kala-azar incidence at elimination unit
concepts.definition: New kala-azar cases per 10,000 population at the source-defined elimination assessment unit.

mappings.rationale: The programme manifestation aligns; elimination assessment specifically depends on the block-level unit and period.

concepts.label: Lymphatic-filariasis microfilaria prevalence
concepts.definition: People positive for microfilariae among people examined in the source-defined survey or assessment.

mappings.rationale: Microfilaria rate represents infection prevalence; survey design and examined population control comparability.

concepts.label: Lymphatic-filariasis mass drug administration coverage
concepts.definition: Eligible or total population consuming the source-defined antifilarial regimen during a mass drug administration round.

mappings.rationale: Coverage may be reported against total or eligible population; the denominator must be explicit before comparison.
